assessments.zone: Rural villages of Masa and eastern Sona-Bata (Mbidi, Kinsiona, Cite Mavudi/Nsanda, Kimpakasa, Mputu, Lukunga) towards the Kinshasa (Mont-Ngafula/Maluku) border
assessments.evidence: Rural villages east of Kasangulu near the Kinshasa provincial border; no source located on armed-group control. Mobondo militia activity has spread from the Kwamouth area towards Kinshasa's eastern outskirts and Kwango since 2022-2024, but no known presence here; assigned to state police by default, low confidence. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

assessments.zone: Towns and villages of Sona-Bata secteur along the RN1/railway corridor and west (Sona Bata mission, Luila/Kingombi, Nsanga, Kindamba, Matanda, Mangiala)
assessments.evidence: Settlements on or near the Kinshasa-Matadi corridor in western Kongo-Central with no reported armed-group activity; PNC posts and state administration are the main force, with FARDC elements present along the corridor. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

assessments.zone: Kasangulu town (territory seat, Masa secteur) and its neighbourhoods Massa, Marial, Mawete, Kiloso
assessments.evidence: Territory seat on the Kinshasa-Matadi road (RN1) about 30 km from Kinshasa; no armed group is known to hold territory in Kasangulu. Order is kept by the PNC commissariat under the territorial administration; urban crime does not amount to territorial control. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines blocked), so this rests on default state presence.

units.CD2015-kasangulu: Kasangulu territory (Kongo-Central) borders Kinshasa to the west/south-west along the RN1 road and railway, far from the eastern conflict zones; no armed group holds territory. Kasangulu town and Sona-Bata secteur are under ordinary state control with the PNC as main force and FARDC elements along the corridor. Eastern rural villages near the Kinshasa border are also assigned to the PNC by default (low confidence) given the westward spread of the Mobondo militia in the region, though no presence here is known. Web research was unavailable for this run, so all zones rest on default state presence.
